steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with the application name 'InnovateHub' and package name 'com.innovatehub.app'.

steps.title: Configure Backend API Schema and Logic
steps.description: Set up api_schema.json, declaring no online backend but documenting the client-side 'project_quote' calculation logic.

steps.title: Set up Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Configure the app's build.gradle file for Java 8 compatibility, SDK versions, and necessary dependencies.

steps.title: Declare Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml, defining the application, main activity, and internet permission for image loading (if applicable).

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout (activity_main.xml)
steps.description: Lay out the primary user interface using a ScrollView and LinearLayout to organize sections like Hero, About, Services, Calculator, Testimonials, and Contact.

steps.title: Implement Hero Section UI
steps.description: Add ImageView for a hero background, TextViews for title and description, and Buttons for calls to action within the main layout.

steps.title: Create About/Core Values Section UI
steps.description: Design a section with TextViews for core values and descriptions, possibly using nested LinearLayouts for a structured appearance.

steps.title: Build Services Section UI
steps.description: Lay out service cards with ImageViews for icons and TextViews for service titles and descriptions.

steps.title: Develop Project Quote Calculator UI
steps.description: Integrate UI elements for the calculator: Spinners for service type and complexity, a SeekBar for estimated hours, CheckBoxes for add-ons, and TextViews to display the calculated total and breakdown.

steps.title: Implement Testimonials Section UI
steps.description: Add UI for client testimonials, using TextViews for quotes and client details, and ImageViews for client avatars.

steps.title: Construct Contact Form UI
steps.description: Design a simple contact form with EditText fields for name, email, and project description, a Spinner for project type, and a Button for submission.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java Logic
steps.description: Write Java code for MainActivity to initialize UI components, handle user interactions, and implement the client-side project quote calculation logic.

steps.title: Add Quote Calculator Logic in Java
steps.description: Develop the `calculateProjectQuote` method within MainActivity to perform the offline calculation based on user inputs from the UI.

steps.title: Integrate Contact Form Simulation Logic
steps.description: Add event listeners and a simple simulation for the contact form submission, displaying a success message locally.

steps.title: Building InnovateHub
steps.description: Assemble the Android application, ensuring all components are correctly integrated and the app builds without errors.
